spec.description: Every job knell watches at once: whether each beat is fresh, when it last checked in, how close it is to its deadline and its outages, with what needs your attention. History charts the check-ins, outages and notices, and knell health shows the scrape and the listener.

spec.title: Beats past their deadline
spec.description: How many beats are past their deadline now, read from the firing KnellBeatOverdue alerts, so it counts a beat once the alert's 5 minutes have passed. Red from 1. Without the rules from alerts/promql.yaml loaded, the tile counts the beats that have been past their deadline for 7 minutes itself.

spec.expr: count(ALERTS{alertname="KnellBeatOverdue", alertstate="firing", instance="$instance"}) or (count(count_over_time((knell_beat_fresh{instance="$instance"} == 0)[7m:1m]) >= 7) unless on () count(max_over_time(ALERTS{alertname="KnellBeatOverdue", instance="$instance"}[7m]))) or vector(0)

spec.title: Beats watched
spec.description: How many beats this knell watches, one per configured beat. A number lower than you configured means knell runs an older configuration. No value means knell was not scraped.

spec.title: Pings accepted in ${span} ${spanunit}
spec.description: Pings knell accepted across every beat in the selected range. A refused ping never counts here, and knell health shows the refusals. No value means knell was not scraped in the range.

spec.title: Outages in ${span} ${spanunit}
spec.description: Outages knell detected across every beat in the selected range, one each time a beat crossed its deadline. Yellow from 1, and the Beats table names the beat. No value means knell was not scraped in the range.

spec.title: knell scrape
spec.description: Shows while the KnellTargetDown alert fires: no scrape of this knell has succeeded for 15 minutes, so every beat it watches is unwatched. Check the container, the port and the network. Needs the rules from alerts/promql.yaml in a ruler that stores its `ALERTS` series beside the metrics, as Prometheus and Mimir do.

spec.title: knell target
spec.description: Shows while the KnellTargetAbsent alert fires: no knell scrape target exists at all, so every other rule is blind. The tile counts every knell, because a missing target carries no instance. Needs the rules from alerts/promql.yaml in a ruler that stores its `ALERTS` series beside the metrics, as Prometheus and Mimir do.

spec.title: Listener
spec.description: Shows while the KnellAcceptFailing alert fires: the listener failed to accept a connection in the last 15 minutes, so pings may not land while the process runs. Check the file descriptor limit. Needs the rules from alerts/promql.yaml in a ruler that stores its `ALERTS` series beside the metrics, as Prometheus and Mimir do.

spec.title: Notices
spec.description: Shows while the KnellNotifyFailing alert fires: a notice failed after its retries, or one will never be sent, in the last 15 minutes. Notices failed or lost on History names the kind. Needs the rules from alerts/promql.yaml in a ruler that stores its `ALERTS` series beside the metrics, as Prometheus and Mimir do.

spec.title: Restarts
spec.description: Shows while the KnellRestartChurn alert fires: knell started more than twice in 26 hours, and each start rearms every deadline. Started on knell health shows the last start. Needs the rules from alerts/promql.yaml in a ruler that stores its `ALERTS` series beside the metrics, as Prometheus and Mimir do.

spec.title: Beats
spec.description: One row per beat: whether it is Fresh or Missing, when knell last accepted a ping for it, its deadline, the share of the deadline left, and its outages in the selected range. Time left is red below 20%, yellow from 20% and green from 50%. Until a beat's first ping, Last seen shows when knell started.

defaults.noValue: No beats, or knell was not scraped

spec.title: Check-ins per beat
spec.description: Pings knell accepted per beat, as bars over the selected range. A beat whose bars stop is the job that stopped checking in. A refused ping is not counted here.

spec.title: Outages per beat
spec.description: Outages knell detected per beat, as bars over the selected range, one each time a beat crossed its deadline. A beat with repeated bars is a job that runs late or fails often. No bars means no beat crossed its deadline.

spec.title: Fresh or missing
spec.description: Each beat's state over the selected range, Fresh in green and Missing in red. A red band is an outage, from the deadline crossing to the next accepted ping. A gap means knell was not scraped.

spec.title: Notices sent
spec.description: Notices knell delivered, by kind, as bars over the selected range. Missing is a beat that crossed its deadline, Recovered one that pinged again, and History a summary of outages that ended. No bars means knell sent nothing.

spec.title: Notices failed or lost
spec.description: Notices that failed after their retries and will be tried again, notices that will never be sent, and outage records knell had to discard, as bars over the selected range. Any bar here means a notice was late or lost. The container log says why.

spec.title: Scrape
spec.description: Whether the last scrape of this knell succeeded, the up series your scraper writes for the job knell. Down means the container is stopped or the scraper cannot reach it, and KnellTargetDown follows. No value means no scrape in the last few minutes.

spec.title: Accept errors in ${span} ${spanunit}
spec.description: Connections the listener failed to accept in the selected range. Red from 1, because pings may have been lost while it lasted. No value means knell was not scraped in the range.

spec.title: Refusals in ${span} ${spanunit}
spec.description: Requests knell refused before reading them in the selected range: a host not in ALLOWED_HOSTS, a beat path spelled in a way the router would rewrite, or sign-in attempts throttled. A steady count points to a job that pings the wrong address. No value means knell was not scraped in the range.

spec.title: Started
spec.description: When this knell process last started. Each start rearms every deadline, so a recent start means a beat's outage is only noticed after a full deadline. No value means knell was not scraped.

spec.title: Refusals by reason
spec.description: Requests knell refused before reading them, by reason, as bars over the selected range. Host not allowed means a job addresses knell by a name missing from ALLOWED_HOSTS. No bars means knell refused nothing.

spec.expr: label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(round(sum by (reason) (increase(knell_pre_route_refusals_total{instance="$instance"}[$__interval]))), "reason", "Beat path spelled oddly", "reason", "non_canonical_beat_path"), "reason", "Host not allowed", "reason", "host_not_allowed"), "reason", "Sign-in throttled", "reason", "auth_throttled")

spec.title: Request latency
spec.description: How long knell took to answer requests, as the median, 90th and 99th percentile over each step of the selected range. A ping answers in milliseconds, so a rise points to a host under load. A gap means knell served no request then.

spec.title: Requests by status
spec.description: Requests knell answered, by HTTP status, as bars over the selected range. 200 is an accepted ping or scrape, 401 a ping with a wrong token and 404 an unknown beat. No bars means knell served no request.

spec.title: knell

spec.name: instance
spec.label: knell
spec.description: The knell to show, by its scrape instance. Each knell watches its own copy of the beats.

spec.name: spanread
spec.label: Range length source
spec.description: Reads the length of the time range for span, spanunit and spanthe, all their words in one answer.

spec.query: query_result(label_replace(label_replace(count_values by (u) ("n", label_replace(round(vector($__range_s / 86400), 0.1) and on () (vector($__range_s) >= 172800), "u", "days", "", "") or on () label_replace(round(vector($__range_s / 3600), 0.1) and on () (vector($__range_s) >= 7200), "u", "hours", "", "") or on () label_replace(round(vector($__range_s / 60)) and on () (vector($__range_s) >= 120), "u", "minutes", "", "") or on () label_replace(round(vector($__range_s)), "u", "seconds", "", "")), "n", "$1 : ", "n", "(.+)"), "u", "$1 : ", "u", "(.+)"))

spec.definition: query_result(label_replace(label_replace(count_values by (u) ("n", label_replace(round(vector($__range_s / 86400), 0.1) and on () (vector($__range_s) >= 172800), "u", "days", "", "") or on () label_replace(round(vector($__range_s / 3600), 0.1) and on () (vector($__range_s) >= 7200), "u", "hours", "", "") or on () label_replace(round(vector($__range_s / 60)) and on () (vector($__range_s) >= 120), "u", "minutes", "", "") or on () label_replace(round(vector($__range_s)), "u", "seconds", "", "")), "n", "$1 : ", "n", "(.+)"), "u", "$1 : ", "u", "(.+)"))

spec.name: span
spec.label: Range length
spec.description: The number of the dashboard time range's length, such as "30" in "30 days", from spanread. It reads "the" until spanread has read a length.

spec.name: spanunit
spec.label: Range unit
spec.description: The unit of the dashboard time range's length, such as "days" in "30 days", from spanread. It reads "range" until spanread has read a length.

spec.name: spanthe
spec.label: Range length with its article
spec.description: The word "the" and the number of the dashboard time range's length, such as "the 30" in "the 30 days", from spanread. It reads "the" until spanread has read a length.

spec.name: attention
spec.label: Attention tiles shown
spec.description: How many Needs attention tiles have data. The row shows only while one does.

spec.query: query_result(count(label_replace(count(0 * max(ALERTS{alertname="KnellTargetDown", alertstate="firing", instance="$instance"})), "tile", "10", "", "") or label_replace(count(0 * max(ALERTS{alertname="KnellTargetAbsent", alertstate="firing"})), "tile", "11", "", "") or label_replace(count(0 * max(ALERTS{alertname="KnellAcceptFailing", alertstate="firing", instance="$instance"})), "tile", "12", "", "") or label_replace(count(0 * max(ALERTS{alertname="KnellNotifyFailing", alertstate="firing", instance="$instance"})), "tile", "13", "", "") or label_replace(count(0 * max(ALERTS{alertname="KnellRestartChurn", alertstate="firing", instance="$instance"})), "tile", "14", "", "")) or vector(0))

spec.definition: query_result(count(label_replace(count(0 * max(ALERTS{alertname="KnellTargetDown", alertstate="firing", instance="$instance"})), "tile", "10", "", "") or label_replace(count(0 * max(ALERTS{alertname="KnellTargetAbsent", alertstate="firing"})), "tile", "11", "", "") or label_replace(count(0 * max(ALERTS{alertname="KnellAcceptFailing", alertstate="firing", instance="$instance"})), "tile", "12", "", "") or label_replace(count(0 * max(ALERTS{alertname="KnellNotifyFailing", alertstate="firing", instance="$instance"})), "tile", "13", "", "") or label_replace(count(0 * max(ALERTS{alertname="KnellRestartChurn", alertstate="firing", instance="$instance"})), "tile", "14", "", "")) or vector(0))
